source.description: Markdown or Typst text. Give one of source, artifact or intake.

artifact.description: The document as an artifact. Give one of source, artifact or intake.

intake.description: A file he sent. Its intake id, like 1234/1; give one of source, artifact or intake.

artifacts.description: Files the source names by artifact id. Images or data the source uses; each id in the source becomes that file's name.

template.description: Report by default. The look of the document; slides start a slide at each level-2 heading.

title.description: Title on page one and in the PDF; it also names the file.

phone.description: Small pages for a phone. Single column and large type.

cite.description: Cite his library as [@key]. Makes his reference library available as refs.bib.

meta.description: Run facts for research. The research template prints model, wall_time, tool_calls, sites and cost.

format.description: Source language. Omitted means typst when a line starts with #set, #import, #let or #show, else markdown.

name.description: Output file name without extension. Omitted uses the title, then the source file name.

pages.description: Pages to show; [1] by default. At most four, each drawn as an image.
